description: Hearth is a Tiger Style static site generator written in Mojo: a single native binary that turns Markdown and templates into a static site, with deterministic output, bounded work, and zero runtime dependencies — no Node, no npm. Compatibility is defined at the output level against a frozen corpus (the CommonMark 0.31.2 suite, a real publication page, and a deterministic 1,000-page bench site) with Zola 0.22.1 as the pinned reference implementation. This deposit is Phase 0: the governing spec, the frozen corpus, and the pinned Mojo 1.1.0 toolchain; the generator itself is Phase 1.
title: Hearth: A Tiger Style Mojo Static Site Generator
